name: ミガカミカガミ -reviver-
detailed_description:
"MIGAKAMIKAGAMI -reviver-"

A horror-themed, 2D pixel-art escape adventure game

A remake of the original MIGAKAMIKAGAMI released in 2015.

Story

The setting is a certain rural village.

There is a local legend about people being spirited away by a god called “Migakami-sama.”

There were two girls, Nae and Mika.

They weren’t sisters by blood, but they were always together.

Mika was still an elementary school student. She adored Nae like a real older sister.

Nae was in junior high school. She loved Mika as if she were her own little sister.

One day, the two of them went shopping in town.

The bus they were riding was involved in an accident.

Nae injured her arm and had to be hospitalized.

Today, Mika has come to visit her in the hospital.

However, the two suddenly realize that their surroundings have turned into an eerie, otherworldly space...

Key Features

  • Deep, carefully crafted horror expressions

  • Two contrasting endings in the main story: a perfect GOOD END and a tragic BAD END, like reflections in a mirror

  • A mystery-style plot with dramatic twists

  • Detailed 2D pixel art graphics

What's New in the Remake

  • Added an EXTRA story, which includes two additional endings

  • Major additions to the story and characters in the main stages

  • Revamped puzzles and mechanics while preserving the original atmosphere

  • Almost all graphics, music, and sound have been renewed

  • New character portraits have been added

  • Higher screen resolution and a larger game display

  • Improved UI with features such as auto-save and difficulty settings

short_description: MIGAKAMIKAGAMI -reviver- is a Horror 2D Pixel art Adventure Escape game. The story is set in a rural hospital where a legend of divine abductions by a deity called "Migakami-sama" has been passed down. The protagonists, Mika and Nae, are caught up in the divine abduction.
